receipt_backfill.procedure: Backfill of the receipt flags lost to the fixed runner bug (traptest/run.py: the pre-9-Nov-2026 final doc rewrite re-read the file from disk, discarding the in-memory receipt_verified_onchain flags). Each row's base64 receipt was decoded to its settlement tx hash (traptest/receipts.py decode_receipt_tx_hash), then verified read-only against the Sepolia public RPC (https://ethereum-sepolia-rpc.publicnode.com) with traptest/harness.py verify_receipts: eth_getTransactionReceipt batch, receipt verifies only when status is 0x1 AND the receipt carries an ERC-20 Transfer log from the accepted token (0xcc194e1a843B658526D0D5C431f670028582Ae17) to payTo (0x3624EB012B5E998BB57B6bE6C9Cfc9c4bc5eb99b) for exactly 10000 atomic ($0.01). The public RPC's backends intermittently return null results with no error (observed 13 Nov 2026: two identical batches returned all-null before a third returned all receipts), so null-result batches were retried (max 10 attempts), re-requesting only the nulls. No purchase, no re-run, no spend; scores, costs and answers untouched — only receipt_verified_onchain + receipt_settlement_tx were added.
